content: The official 24/7 league is currently led by headline equity from Cosmo & Wanda variants, but underlying economics reveal a stark split: both C&W strategies post perfect realized win rates yet suffer severe unrealized drawdowns that erase or threaten net profits, exposing a fleet-wide exit pathology. Timmy Top 50 remains the only net-profitable prospect, translating a 31.7% win rate into positive realized hourly yield, while Timmy Top 20 is underwater despite a higher win rate, suggesting narrower pair coverage is eroding per-trade edge. With one restart-flagged entrant obscuring historical attribution and the incumbent champion flatlined at $0.00 total PnL, the competition is increasingly an audit of post-entry risk management rather than entry accuracy alone.
